name: background-default
description: Default configuration for automated processes (frameworks, scheduled tasks, project tools) when they don't specify their own. Migrated from routing-config.json::pipelines.agent on the Chunk 2 cutover.

depth._note: PUBLISHER 2026-05-30: gear-4 depth/breadth split to distinct OpenRouter models for the run_gear4 cascade. depth=mimo-v2.5, breadth=qwen3.5-plus, fallback qwen3.6-plus. NO Anthropic.

depth._note: PUBLISHER 2026-05-28: production author-tier chain. NO Anthropic API. NO direct OpenAI API. All three entries are OpenRouter, billed against the publisher's OpenRouter account. Used by every MSI pipeline that calls invoke_chat(slot='breadth'|'depth', context='autonomous'): article_generator (news), gear3_orchestrator (columns/EB/phukher/hector/propaganda), analysis_generator, floor_engagement.

consolidation._note: PUBLISHER 2026-05-28 (PM fixup): server has no MLX runtime, so post_analysis primaries that pointed at local-mlx-* models were breaking every invoke_chat(slot="evaluator"|"consolidator"|"formatter", context="autonomous") call. Replaced with the publisher-stated routing: evaluator → Qwen 3.5 Plus, consolidation+formatter → Qwen 3.6 Plus, all on OpenRouter. Fallbacks point only at OpenRouter-resolvable models.

speed._note: MSI SPEED config (news, high volume). Mirrors backfill_orchestrator._BREADTH_CHAIN exactly: fast models lead, smart reasoning models back up. Consumed by the MSI news walker (_invoke) once Move #2 P1 sources the chain from config. Walker/quarantine/uncapped-max_tokens/completeness-gate unchanged — this only relocates the model LIST from a hardcoded constant to the canonical config.

intelligence._note: MSI INTELLIGENCE config (op-eds/analyses/consolidation/headlines/floor/voice prose). Mirrors msi_model_call.DEFAULT_CHAIN exactly: smart reasoning models lead, fast models back up. Consumed by msi_model_call.chain_invoke once Move #2 P1 sources the chain from config. Same walker/quarantine/uncapped behavior.
